original_question:
Write a Verilog module named `sky130_fd_sc_lp__dfxtp`. This module should implement a positive-edge triggered D flip-flop. The module should have the following interface:
Inputs: `D`, `CLK`, `VPB`, `VPWR`, `VGND`, `VNB`
Output: `Q`

The output `Q` should capture the value of the input `D` on the positive edge of the `CLK` signal. The other inputs (`VPB`, `VPWR`, `VGND`, `VNB`) are part of the standard cell interface but do not require specific logic for the basic D flip-flop behavior itself.
